description: Returns owner-only human HTML page views and daily unique visitors for a slug. Inputs: slug, optional from and to as YYYY-MM-DD (default the plan window: 7 days on Free, 30 on Hobby, 90 on Pro), and token. Bots, empty or script user agents, headless browsers, and assets are not page views. A longer range returns plan_required with an upgrade link. No raw IP and no full user agent are stored. The same numbers are on https://deed.page/analytics?slug= with the owner token.

from.description: First UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default is the plan window ending at to.

to.description: Last UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default is today.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

name: site_visits
title: Site visit analytics
